ergebnisse.thema: Democrats win Alaska Senate race two weeks after midterms counting began

aussagen.text: Democrats win Alaska Senate race two weeks after midterms counting began

Democrat Mary Peltola will be Alaska’s next senator after beating the Republican incumbent Dan Sullivan, with the result called two weeks on from midterm elections which saw Donald Trump’s party lose ground across the country.

Alaska was the last Senate race remaining to be called, and with Peltola’s victory, Democrats will control 56 seats in the upper chamber, after winning campaigns in conservative states including South Carolina, Texas, Kansas and Mississippi
Ms Peltola’s win, announced two weeks after the midterms, extends a blue wave that saw the party take control of both the Senate and the House of Representatives.
